title: Two Tennis Stars Are Out of the US Open Because of Injuries
summary:
Have you ever been so excited for a big game or match, and then you couldn't play because you got hurt? That's what happened to two top tennis players. Jannik Sinner, the world's number one, and his friend Jack Draper both had to pull out of the US Open because of injuries.

Sinner has a knee problem. He hasn't played since he won Wimbledon in July. He said, "Even though I have been working hard with my team and my medical staff, we have now had to make the difficult decision that I will not be able to compete at the US Open this year." He also said he is very sad because New York has a special place in his heart.

Draper has a long-term arm injury. He hurt his left serving arm and has bone bruising. He has only played 16 matches in the past year and missed all four Grand Slam tournaments this year. That's really tough.

The good news is that Carlos Alcaraz, Sinner's big rival, is coming back to play at the US Open after being out for four months with a wrist injury. Sinner and Alcaraz have won all the Grand Slam titles in 2024 and 2025, so it's a big deal when they can't both play. Fans were hoping to see them battle again, but now they'll have to wait.
why_it_matters: It shows that even top athletes can be stopped by injuries, just like you might miss a game or activity when you get hurt, and that taking care of your body matters.
